sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Accept. The candidate is semantically faithful for COMPLEX_READINESS: it preserves the ship-owned applicability and operands, case-owned table references, classification, load, demand, evidence, and body relationship, targets thrusterResistanceCapacity on the required thrusterBody owner, requires load cases, conditionally requires correspondence evidence and equivalent sphere radius for non-hemispherical geometry, and implements the explicit DIRECT_CHECK with exact KiloN units and inclusive capacity >= demand comparison. Deterministic validation is valid and no vocabulary repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add sh:minCount 1 to the ship's nltl:hasThrusterIceImpactLoadCase property so an empty ship cannot pass. Implement the declared DIRECT_CHECK by comparing each case's thrusterResistanceCapacity numeric value inclusively against its thrusterIceImpactDemand numeric value (capacity >= demand), with compatible KiloN units; the current shapes only require presence and never enforce that the thruster withstands the demand. Preserve the existing case-owned paths, conditional non-hemispherical radius/evidence requirements, table references, operands, and Complex-readiness boundary.

Repair the contact-geometry alternative: the current sh:or is nested inside the contactGeometryClassification property shape, so its sh:property for contactGeometryCorrespondenceEvidence targets the contactGeometryValue node rather than the required thrusterIceImpactLoadCase owner, and the sh:hasValue branches do not faithfully constrain the classification property. Keep classification on the case and enforce the two controlled values there, with a case-level conditional constraint requiring contactGeometryCorrespondenceEvidence when the case is non-hemispherical. Preserve the existing ship-owned conditional equivalentImpactSphereRadius requirement, all case/body-owned paths and evidence, the ship iceOperatingSpeed operand, the added load-case minCount, and the inclusive capacity >= demand direct check.

Fix the DIRECT_CHECK SPARQL unit comparison: the query currently uses qudt:KiloN, which expands to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/KiloN, while the candidate quantities correctly use http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloN; therefore the query can miss every pair and accidentally pass. Use the exact vocabulary unit IRI (or a dedicated unit prefix) for both demand and capacity, preserving the inclusive capacity >= demand comparison, ship load-case minCount, case-owned paths, conditional non-hemispherical evidence and ship-owned equivalent radius, all operands/evidence/table references, and the COMPLEX_READINESS boundary.

Accept. The candidate is semantically faithful for COMPLEX_READINESS: it preserves the ship-owned applicability and operands, case-owned table references, classification, load, demand, evidence, and body relationship, targets thrusterResistanceCapacity on the required thrusterBody owner, requires load cases, conditionally requires correspondence evidence and equivalent sphere radius for non-hemispherical geometry, and implements the explicit DIRECT_CHECK with exact KiloN units and inclusive capacity >= demand comparison. Deterministic validation is valid and no vocabulary repair is required.
